overview_description.description: Shopular is changing the way people use their mobile phones to shop. Available on iPhone and Android, the innovative mobile app notifies users of personalized sales and coupons when they are near a store or mall. Shopular is the highest rated app in its category and ranked by Time Magazine among the 50 best iPhone apps of 2013.

about_short_description.short_description: Shopular is changing the way people use their mobile phones to shop. The innovative mobile app notifies users of personalized deals.

product.name: Cash Back Program
product.description: A program where members earn a percentage of their purchase back when shopping through the platform or using its extension.

product.name: Express Deals
product.description: A service offering up to 60% off on hotels, flights, and rental cars without bidding. The exact details are revealed after booking.

product.name: Vacation Packages
product.description: Bundled deals combining flights, hotels, and sometimes car rentals for savings up to $625.

product.name: Trip Builder
product.description: A tool allowing users to bundle flights, hotels, and car rentals for multiple destinations into one package for savings.

product.name: In-Store Cash Back
product.description: Members can earn cash back on in-store purchases by linking a credit card and activating offers via the app.

product.name: Mobile App Deals
product.description: Exclusive discounts and deals available through the mobile app, including in-store cash back and booking features.
